tasks.name: Embedded AI coding tools analytics
tasks.description: Embedded AI coding tools — including OpenAI Codex, Snowflake Cortex, and Claude Code — into day-to-day analytical workflows; leveraged Snowflake Cortex specifically for data discovery and rapid PoC development, significantly reducing the time needed to assess data feasibility and validate analytical approaches before full delivery.
tasks.challenge: Speed of insight delivery
tasks.input: Stakeholder requirements
tasks.output: Power BI report or actionable insights
tasks.outcome: Significantly reduced the time required to assess data feasibility and validate analytical approaches prior to full delivery.

tasks.name: Whitespace opportunities analysis
tasks.description: Identified whitespace opportunities for new sales and cross-sell by blending public and internal data sources — engineering a snapshot table sourced from the New Zealand Companies Register using advanced SQL scripting, CTEs, and data transformation logic, feeding into a comprehensive Power BI dashboard built with DAX and a structured data model, enabling stakeholders to track growth, market penetration, and untapped opportunities across dimensions including region, industry, and company size.
tasks.challenge: Upsell & Cross-sell to generate more revenue
tasks.input: Flat files, and CRM data on Snowflake
tasks.output: Automated Power BI dashboard
tasks.outcome: Power BI Dashboard that provides insights on market condition and opportunities

tasks.name: Customer reachability and contact quality KPIs
tasks.description: Uncovered customer reachability and communication quality gaps within the CRM by analysing Salesforce data through advanced SQL scripting and data modelling — flagging business accounts without contactable contacts and accounts missing a primary contact or key decision-maker. Insights were structured into a governed data model and surfaced through an interactive Power BI dashboard, enabling marketing and servicing teams to act on data quality issues — ultimately driving a major revamp of onboarding processes and data entry standards.
tasks.challenge: Effectiveness of marketing and servicing communications
tasks.input: Salesforce data, Snowflake
tasks.output: Automated Power BI dashboard with Customer Reachability and Contact Quality KPIs
tasks.outcome: Enhanced customer communication metrics, directly driving incremental sales conversion rates.

tasks.name: A/B testing with retention curve
tasks.description: Developed retention curves by discount band and designed A/B tests to validate offering strategies, enabling data-driven optimisation that balanced churn reduction with margin protection.
tasks.challenge: High post-campaign churn resulting from customers exiting immediately following promotional discount expirations.
tasks.input: Churn data, discount amounts by service
tasks.output: Retention curves with A/B testing results
tasks.outcome: Optimized, margin-protected campaigns that improved long-term customer retention and lifetime value (LTV).

tasks.name: NPS driver impact analysis
tasks.description: Modelled NPS driver impact to prioritise improvement initiatives, directly linking customer feedback to business outcomes.
tasks.challenge: Low NPS without understanding the causes
tasks.input: NPS survey data (CSV and Snowflake)
tasks.output: Correlation values for each driver
tasks.outcome: Insights on linkage between drivers and NPS

tasks.name: Continuous VoC insight programme
tasks.description: Delivered continuous VoC insight programmes, tracking member sentiment across journey stages and surfacing actionable findings for cross-functional stakeholders.
tasks.challenge: Superficial visibility into customer sentiment without a unified, omni-channel view of customer journey friction points.
tasks.input: NPS survey data (CSV and Snowflake)
tasks.output: Power BI dashboard to show topics from the topic modelling and its movement
tasks.outcome: Delivered cross-functional clarity on systemic customer pain points, enabling targeted operational interventions.

tasks.name: Nationwide 3G network shutdown
tasks.description: Supported the nationwide 3G network shutdown: analysed customer usage and device data to design targeted communication strategies and proactive transition pathways.
tasks.challenge: Customers need to be informed about the shutdown and understand their options
tasks.input: Network and customer device data on Snowflake
tasks.output: Excel with customer segmentation and its suggested handling strategies based on device capability (4G/5G capable)
tasks.outcome: Achieved zero customer complaints during the nationwide 3G network shutdown phase.

tasks.name: Business lead pipeline management

Managed and maintained a business leads pipeline from digital channels, surfacing and tracking prospects
through a Looker Studio dashboard for stakeholder visibility.

tasks.output: A centralized dashboard visualizing cross-channel leads, providing stakeholders with clear visibility into acquisition opportunities.
tasks.outcome: Visualized dashboard on leads from multiple channels to understand the leads and opportunities

tasks.name: Sentiment analysis
tasks.description:
Built and maintained Power BI dashboards; authored Python scripts for sentiment analysis and topic
modelling on open-text customer feedback.

tasks.input: NPS survey data
tasks.output: Topics and the number of mentions
tasks.outcome: The insights provided empirical proof for multiple hypotheses.

tasks.name: Designed and maintained customer and internal survey programmes

tasks.output: Monthly Tableau / PPT report
